subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should OpenClaw add `messages.operationalReplies` as a permanent global config and plugin/runtime delivery contract with `always`, `silent`, `once`, and `redirect` modes?
rationale: The canonical issue already identifies this as a visibility/default policy choice, and this PR expands that choice into persisted state and plugin/runtime contracts; repairing the concurrency bug cannot decide the permanent product surface.

options.title: Accept the global policy
options.body: Keep all four modes, require atomic once semantics and clean current-main integration, then land with live and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow to leak suppression
options.body: Fix the canonical external-channel leak without adding persisted once, redirect, or new plugin contract surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close the PR if operational-notice routing should remain fixed core behavior rather than configurable policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the global policy
recommendation.body: Keep all four modes, require atomic once semantics and clean current-main integration, then land with live and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties the shipped fallback-notice behavior to this owner and shows recent work across the cross-cutting runtime and plugin surfaces involved in the policy decision.
